doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Complete Subsidiary Status of Three Consolidated Subsidiaries Through Simplified Stock Exchange
doc_title_jp: 簡易株式交換による連結子会社３社の完全子会社化に関するお知らせ

key_facts.method: fixed-ratio stock exchange (variable method based on Kumiai's average share price)
key_facts.reason_jp: グループとしての意思決定の迅速化・効率化・柔軟性向上を図り、グループ経営を強化するため

summary_en: Kumiai Chemical will acquire three consolidated subsidiaries—Ihara Kensei Kogyo, Kumika Logistics, and Nihon Printing—through fixed-ratio stock exchanges becoming effective November 1, 2026. Exchange ratios use a variable method tied to Kumiai's average share price in a specified period before the effective date; the ratio for Ihara Kensei is set at 1,543 yen divided by Kumiai's average share price. The transaction streamlines group decision-making and strengthens consolidated operations.
summary_jp: クミアイ化学がイハラ建成工業、クミカ物流、日本印刷工業の連結子会社3社を簡易株式交換により完全子会社化する。2026年11月1日の効力発生を予定。交換比率は変動性方式で、イハラ建成は基準株価1,543円を当社平均株価で除した比率。グループの迅速な意思決定と経営強化が目的。
tag_en: M&A: Three subsidiaries fully acquired via stock exchange
